name: Circuit Border
description: Rounded corners and a window border textured as a hex circuit, with bright data pulses travelling around the band over a dim base grid. The cells flicker faintly and the whole band dims when the surface loses focus.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Corner radius
parameters.description: Roundness of the corners (px, 0 for square)

parameters.name: Round bottom corners
parameters.description: Round the bottom corners as well as the top. Turn off to round only the top two, for a pane that sits against a panel or the screen edge. The whole chain follows one answer, so the bottom corners are all rounded or all square.

parameters.name: Edge softness
parameters.description: Anti-alias feather of the border and the pane edge, in device pixels, so it does not grow with display scaling. Lower is a crisper hairline.

parameters.name: Pulse count
parameters.description: How many data pulses travel the band at once

parameters.name: Pulse speed
parameters.description: How many times per second each pulse travels around the border

parameters.name: Grid colour
parameters.description: Colour of the dim base circuit grid

parameters.name: Pulse colour
parameters.description: Colour of the travelling data pulses
